event_envelope.correlation_id: u64 opaque identifier shared across device, transport, host, and provider events
event_envelope.event_sequence: u32 source-local sequence ordered within a correlation id
event_envelope.monotonic_ms: u32 source-local monotonic timestamp; cross-source comparison uses causal order plus paired timing metrics
event_envelope.timing_value_ms: u32 value for timing_metric, zero only when timing_metric is none

ble_diag_log_gatt.chunk_header_layout: event_count u16 LE, global_offset u32 LE, events_crc32 u32 LE (CRC-32/IEEE over the packed event payload)
ble_diag_log_gatt.count_value: read returns JSON {"count":N} with the number of retained events
ble_diag_log_gatt.pull_semantics: host subscribes to data notifications, writes {"op":"start"} to control, then for each chunk writes {"op":"read","offset":N} and receives one data notification carrying chunk_header_bytes header plus event_count packed event_wire_bytes events; host writes {"op":"stop"} to end the session
